Body.Content:
When enabled through feature control, this feature lets you configure a default booking method in the Schedule Board settings. The selected default booking method is automatically applied during booking. You can override the default by changing the booking method at the time of booking.

Business Value:

The Configurable booking method feature ensures consistent and predictable resource bookings by allowing organizations to set a default booking allocation method across the Schedule Board and Schedule Assistant. This reduces the risk of incorrect bookings caused by inconsistent defaults, minimizes rework and cancellations, and saves time for resource managers.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: September CY2026
